1.consolidated_definition: med. Médico generalista, médico de familia. Médico no especialista que provee cuidado primario a una comunidad. Sigla anglicada, poco frecuente. El elemento central de esta propuesta es la educación continuda del médico y sus colaboradores en los fundamentos diagnósticos, clínicos y terapeúticos de la medicina familiar ambulatoria, al estilo del GP (general practitioner) de Gran Bretaña, a un país en desarrollo (Fundación ILADIBA, consultado 14-11-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: General Practitioner (GP), Family Physician. Non-specialist physician providing primary care to a community. Anglicized abbreviation, infrequently used. The central element of this proposal is the continuous education of the physician and their collaborators in the fundamental diagnostic, clinical, and therapeutic principles of ambulatory family medicine, similar to the GP model in the United Kingdom, adapted for a developing country (ILADIBA Foundation, consulted 14-11-08)
